page.overview:
Who is Callowyn Royce?

was the younger brother of Lady Aranessa Royce.

Callowyn was described as a jovial, happy, and wonderful man with broad forearms.

Callowyn was born as the grandson of Lord Royce around three decades after the end of the Shapers' War. He had an older sister, Aranessa, who eventually became the head of their family, having connections with the heir of House Davinos, Julien, and marrying a war hero that ended up becoming a rebel, Thjazi Fang.

Callowyn, on the other hand, spent time in their house's estate in the Golden Orchard, and eventually became the owner of a family heirloom: a pair of bracers the fair folk of Hallow had given them long ago, which gave whoever used them the strength and might of oak and birch.
